keyFeatures: Daily behavior tracking across 4 Jungian archetypes: King, Warrior, Magician, and Lover
Visualizes which archetypes are active, overdeveloped, or underdeveloped in your daily life
Grounded in Jungian psychology and Robert Moore's four mature masculine/feminine archetypes
Guides you toward integrating all four archetypes for psychological wholeness and balance
tips: Log behaviors daily for at least a week before drawing conclusions — single-day snapshots can be misleading due to situational factors.
An overdeveloped archetype is as problematic as an underdeveloped one — the goal is balance across all four, not maximizing any single one.
